topic: The Mathematical Trinity: Powers, Roots, and Logarithms

sections.title: The Foundation: Exponential Growth (1 min)
lecture_lines: Growth starts with a base seed. [Asset: TreeSeed]
The exponent is the growth engine. [Asset: GrowthEngine]
Base two branches each step. [Asset: BaseTwoBranch]
Repeated doubling creates exponential power. [Asset: ExponentialPower]
Three steps result in eight. [Asset: RabbitPopEight]
animations: Display central exponential function f(x) = b^x in #FFFFFF color.
Animate growth curve upward with a tracer point.
Flash the base 'b' while highlighting it in #FFD700.
Show rapid expansion of y-values relative to x.

sections.title: The Inverse Shift: Roots (1.5 min)
lecture_lines: We have the grown result. [Asset: GrownTree]
How do we find the base? [Asset: BaseQuestionMark]
Radicals undo the exponent's growth. [Asset: RadicalUndoing]
animations: Show exponential curve f(x) = b^x and its reflection line y = x.
Animate transformation of curve across y=x to create inverse.
Display resulting root function g(x) = x^(1/b) in #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Time Seeker: Logarithms (1.5 min)
lecture_lines: We know the total population. [Asset: TotalPop]
We need the missing time. [Asset: MissingTime]
Logarithms reveal the exponent elapsed. [Asset: LogRevealsTime]
animations: Highlight y in #FF4500 to represent the unknown time exponent.
Visualize log_b(x) = y as a mechanism seeking the exponent.

sections.title: Synthesizing the Trinity (1 min)
lecture_lines: Powers, roots, logs are linked. [Asset: TrinityCircle]
Base to power gives result. [Asset: PowerLink]
Result back to base gives root. [Asset: RootLink]
animations: Display f, g, and log connected in a circle.
Color f red (#FF0000), g blue (#0000FF), log green (#00FF00).
Pulse connection lines to show bidirectional dependencies.
